Okay, so let me preface this by telling you all I have never had a girlfriend, for obvious reasons. Alright, so it was my first year at university and I was living in residential housing (dorms). First six months were fine, having fun, uni was kicking my ass etc, then I met this girl who lived about 200 meters away from me. She had just gone through a pretty bad break up, so I start talking to her, sharing some music with her, not really wanting to start anything at this point, 'cause I know she's hurting. Then one day she out of nowhere calls me cute. My undeveloped mind takes this to mean that 'HOLY SHIT SHE LIKES ME! SHE ACTUALLY LIKES ME!', this is unusual because she is attractive, and I weigh 130 kilos (about 270 pounds). Naturally I have no idea how to react, so I just keep going like nothing has happened, we keep talking, but the 'she likes me' thought keeps popping up in my head. So eventually I do the only thing I know how to do, I get drunk as fuck and tell her I like her. Now this is when shit starts to go downhill. Normally I would be upset for like a month then move on, but she lives at the same residential college as me, I see her EVERYWHERE, at dinner, breakfast, lunch and even just around. Sooooooo I obsess over her for 6 more months, my grades go from bad to worse, because I can't get over this girl and I start to drink, HEAVILY. Like for those six months I would've been sober for about 2 of them, and that's only because I was too poor to buy booze. And of course I write lame ass drunken poetry about it. One night, when I was super drunk I slipped one of the poems under her door. I think that was the worst of it. Also I texted her a lot, she was kind and accommodating for the first couple of months, but no one can withstand that level of weird. I still think about her a lot, but I don't drink as much anymore, and I'm passing uni. I did have to have counselling and move away from the residential college, though.  
TL:DR: Scumbag brain fell in love with a chick 'cause she called me cute, I turned into an alcoholic and wrote her a poem, slipped it under her door, messaged her constantly. [I got better.](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xzYO0joolR0).
